experiments.hypothesis: A compact CNN may classify these slices at lower computational cost.
experiments.changed_setting: Three convolution blocks, LR 1e-3, unit inputs, batch 32, FP16, no augmentation. Separate architecture baseline.
experiments.interpretation: Reference model. Architecture, normalization and training differ from ConvNeXt.

experiments.hypothesis: BF16 may avoid the skipped updates observed with FP16.
experiments.changed_setting: Replace FP16 with BF16. LR 3e-4, unit inputs, no augmentation. Includes its one-epoch trial.
experiments.interpretation: Zero skipped updates in the recorded BF16 lineage, but weak validation discrimination.

experiments.hypothesis: Centered intensities may improve optimization from scratch.
experiments.changed_setting: Scale [0,1] to [-1,1], retaining LR 3e-4 and no augmentation.
experiments.interpretation: Validation accuracy increased relative to unit inputs. No anatomical mechanism established.

experiments.changed_setting: Initial LR 3e-4 to 3e-5, centered inputs, no augmentation.
experiments.interpretation: Lower selected validation loss than the centered LR 3e-4 run.

experiments.hypothesis: Small geometric variation may improve generalization.
experiments.changed_setting: Add rotations +/-7 degrees, translations up to 5% and scale 0.95-1.05. LR 3e-5.

experiments.hypothesis: Additional training may improve a run still progressing at epoch 20.
experiments.changed_setting: Resume the preceding checkpoint for 10 more epochs, with unchanged configuration.
experiments.interpretation: Chosen for the original frozen evaluation. Continuation, not an independent initialization.

experiments.hypothesis: Additional epochs might reduce remaining validation loss.
experiments.changed_setting: Resume the 30-epoch lineage toward 40, preserving the existing scheduler and stopping rule.
experiments.interpretation: Stopped at 39. Modest validation gain. No test evaluation of this checkpoint.

experiments.hypothesis: LR 1e-4 may balance progress against instability.
experiments.changed_setting: Fresh seed-42 run, LR 1e-4 instead of 3e-5, centered inputs and mild affine augmentation.
experiments.interpretation: Improved validation loss relative to the LR 3e-5 lineage. Different stopping epochs also affect the comparison.

experiments.hypothesis: Excluding biases and 1D parameters may improve regularization.
experiments.changed_setting: Keep decay 0.01 for multidimensional weights, use 0 for biases, normalization and layer-scale parameters.
experiments.interpretation: Improved validation loss versus all-parameter decay.

experiments.hypothesis: Averaged weights may provide a better validation model.
experiments.changed_setting: Enable fixed EMA decay 0.999 after successful optimizer updates. EMA validation loss drives scheduler, selection and stopping.
experiments.interpretation: Lowest selected validation loss among the recorded ConvNeXt runs. Current preferred model.

experiments.hypothesis: A planned LR trajectory may improve optimization over plateau decay.
experiments.changed_setting: Replace plateau scheduling with 3 warmup epochs, start factor 0.01 and cosine decay over a fixed 40-epoch horizon. Retain EMA and grouped decay.
experiments.interpretation: Stopped at 24 before the full cosine tail. Validation loss worsened, so retain the plateau EMA control.

publication_scope: Aggregate evidence for the experiments discussed in the report and five case illustrations. No source JPEGs, patient manifests, checkpoints or per-image prediction exports.

ema.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast without gradient scaling

definitions.input: Float32 grayscale [0,1] after existing Pillow bilinear resize to 224x224, before model scaling
definitions.contrast: For x>0, clip(mu+factor*(x-mu),0,1), mu=per-image mean of nonzero pixels. Keep original zero pixels zero. This is not a brain mask.
definitions.gamma: x**gamma for gamma 0.9 and 1.1, no clipping or requantization
definitions.translation: Integer shift 4 pixels left/right/up/down, zero fill, no wraparound or interpolation
definitions.crop: Remove four pixels at every edge of resized image, then bilinear 216x216 to 224x224, align_corners=False, antialias=True
definitions.normalization: After perturbation use each checkpoint's saved scaling, then repeat grayscale into three equal channels
definitions.precision: Full validation uses saved evaluation AMP precision and batch size. Repeat five selected cases in FP32 and native AMP with the same five-case batch.
definitions.review_candidates: Existing EMA confidence rule alone, OR model disagreement, OR slice/patient-mean disagreement, OR either disagreement. No fitted thresholds.
definitions.interpretation: One-factor-at-a-time exploratory sensitivity analysis after case inspection. Changes show sensitivity to these interventions, not original error causation, anatomical mechanisms or proven generalization gains.

sensitivity.scope: Validation only. Diagnostic case arrays are ordered by report case number 1-5.

definitions.blur_0.5: After existing resize, 5x5 normalized Gaussian convolution, sigma 0.5 pixel, reflect padding
definitions.blur_1.0: After existing resize, 5x5 normalized Gaussian convolution, sigma 1.0 pixel, reflect padding
definitions.roundtrip_216: Resize full 224x224 image to 216x216 then back to 224x224, no crop, torch bilinear align_corners=False antialias=True
definitions.source_bicubic: Replace only original source JPEG resize with Pillow bicubic 224x224
definitions.aspect_preserving: Fit source grayscale JPEG within 224x224 using bilinear resize, rounded dimensions, symmetric zero padding with odd extra pixel at bottom/right. Changes framing and resampling as well as aspect ratio.
definitions.neighbour_mean: Arithmetic mean P(AD) of this slice and the closest available lower/higher slice IDs within the same patient, two slices at endpoints, three elsewhere. No physical slice spacing assumed.
definitions.other_slices_mean: Mean P(AD) of every other available slice of the same patient, excluding the target slice
definitions.limits: Exploratory tests of model sensitivity, not anatomical diagnosis or proof of clinically label-preserving transforms. Context predictions require additional images and are secondary to individual-slice evaluation.

neighbour_mean.interpretation: Secondary per-slice context predictions, requiring other patient slices. Not primary individual-slice evaluation.

other_slices_mean.interpretation: Secondary per-slice context predictions, requiring other patient slices. Not primary individual-slice evaluation.
